verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe prompt caching with `cache_control`, offering automatic or explicit breakpoints and 5-minute or 1-hour TTLs, and state it cuts both cost and latency on repeated prefixes. The pricing docs publish per-model cache write (5m/1h) and cache hit prices alongside base input and output prices. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the caching savings and latency gains.
